summary: Backend payment regression passed (6/6). Frontend edit-save-reopen payment persistence matrix passed on real API for 4 payment types, including readonly #1/#2 and province->district reset guard. One blocking UI issue remains: 'Yeni Sipariş' header toggle does not open form in browser, preventing full create-form regression from UI path.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='new-order-button'] does not switch to form (button text stays 'Yeni Sipariş', submit button never appears). Reproduced 3 times in browser automation.

action_items: Fix header new-order toggle runtime behavior so form opens from 'Yeni Sipariş' button.
After fix, rerun only missing UI path: create-form open -> payment placeholder empty -> submit blocked without payment -> explicit payment required.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderManagement JSX and state logic looks correct statically (setShowForm(!showForm)), but runtime click does not transition; likely event/overlay/state-sync issue outside static handler definition.
Payment persistence scope fix in OrderForm is validated in real edit/update flows; no regression seen for payment/color/base/district value retention.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEMP_UI_EDIT_* fixture orders via real API (one per payment type) and cleaned all tracked IDs after tests.
closeout_resolution: Superseded by iteration_4.json: new-order HIGH report was transient login-success Sonner toast intercepting force-click, not a navigation bug. Focused create regression passed after waiting for toast; no application code change required. Payment edit matrix remains passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Completed and passed: edit-only matrix (4 payment values), change-only amount/note save path, deliberate payment change persistence, cancel unsaved payment change, cross-order stale-state check, readonly #1/#2 open-cancel values, province-change district reset + save, desktop/mobile payment-area overflow check, no controlled/uncontrolled warnings. Blocked path: create-form cannot be opened from header button in UI. Per loop-prevention, stopped after 3 repeated selector/test failures on new-order toggle.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login as admin -> orders table visible -> click [data-testid='new-order-button'] (force click also tried) -> UI remains on table, button text remains 'Yeni Sipariş', [data-testid='submit-order-button'] never appears. This blocks full in-UI create-form verification. Suggested mitigation: inspect runtime event handling/overlays/state transitions around header controls and any parent re-render conditions preventing showForm=true render branch.
